comment: Which voice the reels speak with. Swap `engine` and re-run scripts/build_audio.py to A/B; each engine writes its own public/audio/<slug>.<engine>.mp3, so both survive side by side and only `engine` decides which one the render picks up.

piper.comment: Free, local, no API key. Voice models are fetched by scripts/fetch_voices.sh into .voices/.

kokoro.comment: Free and local, warmer than piper but a heavier install (torch + a 350MB checkpoint).

elevenlabs.comment: Paid. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment; nothing is sent anywhere unless `engine` is set to this.
